description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Ice Mode I: Squall] and [Ice Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Ice Mode I: Squall
description.text: Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Renzokuken Icebreaker after casting Ice abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Ice Mode II: Squall]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Ice Mode II: Squall
description.text: Instant cast speed for Ice abilities, grants [100% Critical 1] and [Damage Cap +10000 1]/[100% Critical 1], [Damage Cap +20000 1], [Deadly Strikes +20% 1] and [Ice Ability +30% Boost 1] to the user after using Ice abilities if the user has Lion's Savvy level 0-1/2

description.name: Deadly Strikes +20% 1
description.text: Critical hits deal 20% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient and other Critical Damage statuses)

description.name: Dual Renzokuken Icebreaker
description.text: Three single attacks (0.64/0.67/0.71 each) if the user has Lion's Teachings level 0/1/2, 0%/50%/100% additional critical chance if the user has Lion's Savvy level 0/1/2, grants Lion's Savvy +1 to the user, 100% hit rate

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3
